name: Probe characters
description: Turns a one-line character idea into a hand-painted full-body concept sheet on a neutral studio backdrop — reach for it when building a cast for a dark fantasy RPG.

variables.name: character_description
variables.label: Character description
variables.hint: A sentence or two naming who they are, then two or three concrete physical details — build, hair or beard, wardrobe, wear and grime. E.g. 'A gaunt elven poacher, wiry and long-limbed, hair matted with pine resin, deerhide coat patched at the elbows.'
variables.default: A grizzled dwarven smith, broad and low-slung, beard braided with iron rings, soot ground into the creases of his hands.

subject.headline: full-body character concept on a plain slate backdrop
subject.action: standing in a neutral A-pose for a character sheet

environment.description: plain slate background, featureless studio sweep with no props or set dressing

style.medium: Hand-painted texture, thick confident brushwork, visible canvas grain. No text, no watermark, no border.
